comment: Metadata for the conformance corpus. Every key except `_meta` is a case id:
the path of the case relative to tests/conformance/, without the .pengu
feature    free-form tag naming the language feature the case pins
platforms  list of linux/macos/windows the case is meaningful on; a case
whose list does not contain the current platform is skipped
(use this instead of a scattered pytest.skip)
flags      extra compiler defines the case needs, e.g. ["debug"]
requires   reserved: named prerequisites the runner must satisfy
An entry naming a case that does not exist fails
the only reserved key on purpose: a general `_`-prefix rule would have
swallowed every `_smoke/*` entry and silently disabled their platforms.

compliance/s040_not_automatic.pins: The compiler releases nothing at scope exit: `banish` frees now and `defer banish` schedules it (LIFO); a returned value belongs to the caller, and banishing a literal is a safe no-op (`is_owned == 0`).
compliance/s040_not_automatic.title: What Is Not Automatic

compliance/s041_container_store.pins: `push`/`put` copy the element bytes with `memcpy` and never clone a heap payload, so the store and the source alias one buffer — you release it once, by hand; a container only frees its own buffer.
compliance/s041_container_store.title: Containers: `memcpy` on Store, Explicit Release

compliance/s042_imports_modules.title: Imports & modules

compliance/s044_char_opaque_bytes.pins: C-string interop via `ref to char`, opaque handles behind `ref to`, `bytes of`.
compliance/s044_char_opaque_bytes.title: `ref to char`, `opaque`, `.d.pengu`, and `bytes of`

compliance/s045_literals.pins: decimal/hex/binary/underscored integers, float forms, char escapes, typed null.

compliance/s049_ranges_membership.pins: `a to b` half-open ranges in iteration and `in` membership tests.
compliance/s049_ranges_membership.title: Ranges & membership

compliance/s052_with_builders.title: Block-style construction (`with:` expressions)

compliance/s053_with_collections.pins: leading-dot built-in methods inside `with list:` / `with map:` scopes.
compliance/s053_with_collections.title: `with` scopes on collections (`list` and `map`)

compliance/s054_standard_library.pins: pure std modules (spark, scrolls, arithmancy, oracle) called from one program.
compliance/s054_standard_library.title: Standard library

errdefer/err_of_return.pins: `return calling err_of with e` runs errdefer; `ok_of` does not.

errdefer/err_of_return_qualified.pins: the qualified `calling oracle.err_of with e` spelling runs errdefer.

errdefer/lifo_order.pins: several errdefers on one failure path run in LIFO order.

errdefer/maybe_none_return.pins: `return maybe none` runs errdefer; a `some` return does not.

errdefer/or_return_maybe_none.pins: `or return maybe none` runs errdefer before leaving the function.

errdefer/try_propagation.pins: `try` over `maybe T` runs errdefer on the propagated failure.

syntax/method_chain.pins: single-line method chaining lowers each link to a temporary; `with` args bind to the last link.

syntax/method_chain_multiline.pins: `.`-prefixed continuation lines fold into the chain line, preserving line count.

syntax/multiple_returns.pins: `into (int, bool)` tuple returns, compound-literal emission and destructuring unpack.

syntax/noreturn_export.pins: @noreturn emits _Noreturn and requires void; @export pins the C symbol and survives DCE.

syntax/parenthesised_destructuring.pins: the LANGUAGE.md §5.1 form `let (x, y) is p` parses like `let x, y is p`.

syntax/short_struct_init.pins: `with a, b` shorthand, with the long form and call argument lists unaffected.
